title: Grandma's Lake Glows After NOON 🌙
description:
Nobody swims my grandma's lake after noon. The water gets warm, and something down there glows. Grandma says it's the moon, sleeping.

I help her at the lake every weekend. One hot Saturday afternoon, while she napped, I jumped in anyway.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment MOON if you'd have jumped in too.
